natural_WAN_limit: A was observed advancing past 150 seconds, then stalled/retried and was deliberately interrupted. No evidence of a complete naturally-slow (>150s) A replica; the successful full uploads required replacement. Injected slow-read success is separately recorded.

local_followup.confirmed_gap: One transient EOF or HTTP 503 after a successful replan could abort the upload; reproduced with an isolated local overlay.
local_followup.patch: Same-binding read-only status query: at most three transient retries, 100/200ms backoff; successful invalid identities/progress and permanent errors fail immediately. No progress/Done/epoch is created by errors.
local_followup.other_regression_issue: A full local race run caught unsynchronized bytes.Buffer log capture in master/scanner_test.go with late test-node heartbeat logs. Repaired the test helper with a mutex; production scanner/node not changed.
